system_prompt: You prepare product information for a Digital Product Passport. You have tools to list and read the sources available for a product, to get its ERP record, and to submit a candidate value with its exact supporting quote for automated checks. Find the value of information element E03 (Frame material composition by mass share) for product W-100 and submit it for checks. When you are finished, reply with only a JSON object: {"status": "proposed" or "unresolved", "value": ..., "source_id": ..., "quote": ..., "reason": ...}.

# TEST REPORT NW-PR-2025-031
## Calculation of thermal transmittance according to EN ISO 10077-1 and EN ISO 10077-2
*Fictitious test report. Illustrative research data only.*

| | |
|---|---|
| Client | Nordwin Ikkunat Oy, Lahti |
| Product | W-100 Timber-Aluminium Casement |
| Report ID | NW-PR-2025-031 |
| Date of issue | 14 March 2025 |
| Laboratory | Fictitious Building Physics Laboratory, Tampere |

## 1. Specimen description
Single-sash inward-opening casement window, laminated pine frame with aluminium cladding.
Glazing: triple glazing 4-14-4-14-4, one low-e coating, argon filled (90 %).

## 2. Result
For the reference size 1230 x 1480 mm (EN 14351-1, Annex E):
Uw = 1.2 W/(m2K)

# MATERIAL DECLARATION — Frame components
*Fictitious supplier and product. Illustrative research data only.*

**Supplier:** Pohjan Profiili Oy, Oulu (supplier no. 20417)
**Customer:** Nordwin Ikkunat Oy
**Customer article no.:** W-100
**Supplier article no.:** PP-FR-100 / PP-SA-100
**Declaration no.:** PP-MD-2026-118 · **Date:** 2 September 2026 · **Valid until:** 31 August 2027

## 1. Scope
This declaration covers the profile sets delivered for the customer article W-100.
Fittings, glazing and hardware supplied by other suppliers are not included.

## 2. Material composition by mass (%)

| Component | Pine wood | Aluminium | EPDM | Steel | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Frame profile set (PP-FR-100) | 78 | 18 | 3 | 1 | 100 |
| Sash profile set (PP-SA-100) | 74 | 21 | 4 | 1 | 100 |

Frame profile set, share of frame mass: pine wood 78 %, aluminium 18 %, EPDM seals 3 %, steel fittings 1 %.

## 3. Recycled content
Aluminium: 35 % post-consumer recycled content (supplier declaration, not third-party verified).
Pine wood: from PEFC-certified forests (certificate PEFC/02-31-123).

## 4. Substances
No substances of very high concern (SVHC) above 0,1 % (w/w) according to the REACH Candidate List of 25 June 2026.

Signed: Quality Manager, Pohjan Profiili Oy
